verdict.rationale: Notion's API supports webhooks for real-time event triggers (page updates, comments) and personal access tokens for scripts/workers, which could underpin an external automation that reacts to events, but the evidence never shows a native scheduled/cron-style trigger for recurring workflows. missing for 10: documentation of a built-in schedule/recurring trigger (e.g., 'run every day/week'), first-party automation examples for routine team tasks, independent confirmation of scheduled workflows working in practice.
